_about: Per-sport render policy (spec 7.19 / 11.9). block_minutes drives card width; lane_policy alt_lane = overlapping games on one network stack into lanes (CFB), market_filter = the market decides which regional game is on the row; primary_line spread|moneyline. title is the header lockup; week_label true = 'WEEK N' from the fixture week. local_row_label is the rail text for a synthesized local row whose carrier is TBA. prime_window_start (D2) is the local ET 24-hour time at which this sport's prime viewing window opens. It is a POLICY, not a schedule: the window a given day uses is the EARLIEST prime_window_start among the sports that actually have a game that day, and its close is the last program end (kickoff + that sport's block_minutes) - derived in web/lib/primewindow.js, never stored.
